# FastGrid HTML Examples and tutorials

This folder contains HTML examples and tutorials demonstrating the `FastGrid` JavaScript grid in any HTML page or JavaScript framework.

## Generated by

```bash
npm create create-fastgrid-html@latest
```

## Run

Open `index.html` directly for the quick start, or run a local HTTP server by e.g. `npx serve` for examples that load local files.

## What this example demonstrates

- official FastGrid integration for HTML and JavaScript;
- FastSheet spreadsheet capabilities using the same runtime;
- `FGridE.js` trial runtime for evaluation;
- FastGrid API methods and event integration;
- data grids, tree grids, virtual scrolling and editable cells;
- sorting, filtering, grouping, pivoting and export where included.


## Using `FastGrid` in your own project

### Install the package:
copy FGridE.js file to your project where is visible to browser, usually in some public folder. 
The newest FastGrid script can be downloaded from https://www.treegrid.com/attach/FGrid/FGridE.js

### Import:
```html
<script src="path/FGridE.js"></script>
```

### Minimal usage:
```html
<fast-grid src="{ Cols:["A","B","C"], Head:[ "Header" ], Body:[ { V:[1,2,3] }, { V:[4,5,6] }, { V:[7,8,9] } ] }" style="height:500px;"></fast-grid>
```

### Dynamic create:
```html
<div id="GridTag" style="height:500px;"></div>
<script>var grid = FGrid.FastGrid({ Cols:["A","B","C"], Head:[ "Header" ], Body:[ { V:[1,2,3] }, { V:[4,5,6] }, { V:[7,8,9] } ] }, "GridTag")</script>
```

## Access FastGrid API 

```html
<fast-grid id='Grid1' src='src'></fast-grid>
// later use the API in <script>
FGrid.Grids.Grid1?.Get(1, "A");
FGrid.Grids.Grid1?.Set(1, "A", "", "XXX", 1);
```

## Assign events

```html
<fast-grid id='Grid1' src='[src,{Events:{OnClick:onClick}}]'></fast-grid>
<script>function onClick(G,row,col){alert("Clicked "+row?.id+","+col?.id");}</script>
```

## Complete usage snippet

```html
<script src="https://www.treegrid.com/FGrid/FGridE.js"></script>
<script>
   function readValue() { alert("Read value from cell [1,A]: "+ FGrid.Grids.Simple_Grid.Get(1,"A"));  }
   function changeValue(grid,row,col,val) { grid.Set(row,col,"",val,1); }
   function onSetValue(grid,row,col,value,changes){ if(changes) console.log("Value "+value+" set to cell ["+row.id+","+col.id+"]"); }
   function onClick(grid,row,col){ if(row&&col) console.log("clicked cell ["+row.id+","+col.id+"] with value "+grid.GetValue(row,col)); }
   function onReady(grid){ console.log("FastGrid is ready"); }
   FGrid.Sources.Layout1 = { Cols: ["A", "B", { id: "C", Width:80 } ], Head: [ "Header" ], Body: [ { V:[100,200,300] }, { V:{A:400,B:500,C:600} }, { V:"|700|800|900" } ] };
   FGrid.Sources.Events1 = { Events: { OnSetValue: onSetValue, OnReady: onReady, OnClick: onClick  } }; 
</script>
<fast-grid src="['Layout1','Events1']" id="Simple_Grid" style="height:500px;"></fast-grid>
<button onClick="readValue()">Read value [1,A]</button>
<button onClick="changeValue(FGrid.Grids.Simple_Grid,1,'A','XXX');">Change value [1,A]</button>
```
